definition: First-time account creation and initial identity verification for a new user.
include_when: The incident describes creating a new account, initial face/biometric/video verification, initial digital signature for account activation, or initial CCCD submission for a new account.
exclude_when: The incident describes updating an existing account profile (phone, CCCD), recovering access after lockout, or routine login. These belong to ACCOUNT_PROFILE_MAINTENANCE or LOGIN_AUTHENTICATION.
typical_user_goal: Open a new TCInvest account and complete identity verification.
common_confusions: ACCOUNT_PROFILE_MAINTENANCE (updating existing account info); LOGIN_AUTHENTICATION (routine login after account exists).
notes: Supported by 9 Phase B incidents. Initial KYC only; existing-account identity updates belong to ACCOUNT_PROFILE_MAINTENANCE.

definition: Updating or maintaining an existing account profile, including contact information changes, identity document updates, account recovery after lockout, and preference settings.
include_when: The incident describes changing phone number, updating CCCD on an existing account, recovering access after losing a phone or being locked out, saving widget/preference settings, or post-registration digital signature tasks.
exclude_when: The incident describes initial account creation or routine login. These belong to ACCOUNT_OPENING_KYC or LOGIN_AUTHENTICATION.
typical_user_goal: Update personal information or recover access to an existing account.
notes: New stage added based on 7 Phase B incidents (5 ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_PROFILE_CHANGE + 1 ONBOARDING_KYC + 1 UX_NAVIGATION_COMPLEXITY). Supported by repeated evidence of existing-account profile update friction.

definition: Routine access to an existing account via password, OTP, iOTP, biometric, or device authorization.
include_when: The incident describes failed login, missing iOTP, biometric login failure, device authorization failure, or session management issues for an existing account.
exclude_when: The incident describes initial KYC face verification for registration (ACCOUNT_OPENING_KYC) or account recovery after lockout (ACCOUNT_PROFILE_MAINTENANCE).
typical_user_goal: Log in to an existing TCInvest account.
common_confusions: ACCOUNT_OPENING_KYC (initial biometric registration); ACCOUNT_PROFILE_MAINTENANCE (recovery after lockout).
notes: Supported by 9 Phase B incidents. Existing-account login and OTP only; distinguish initial KYC.

definition: Moving funds into or out of the TCInvest account, including deposits, withdrawals, bank linking, and fund availability.
include_when: The incident describes uncredited deposit, blocked withdrawal, failed bank linking, delayed fund availability, or fund validation issues.
exclude_when: The incident describes a display-only balance issue without confirmed movement failure (PORTFOLIO_TRACKING) or a fee complaint without a movement failure.
common_confusions: PORTFOLIO_TRACKING (display-only balance issues); FEE_PRICING (fee complaints without movement failure).
notes: Supported by 16 Phase B incidents. Deposit and withdrawal combined because Phase B evidence does not support splitting. Strawman proposed FUNDING and WITHDRAWAL as separate stages; combined here pending further evidence.

definition: Placing, modifying, cancelling, confirming, or executing an order, including order-entry context and order status.
include_when: The incident describes inability to place/sell/cancel/modify an order, wrong order input, missing order-entry price/quantity context, or order status issues.
exclude_when: The incident describes a generic app freeze without stated order impact (GENERAL_CROSS_JOURNEY) or viewing holdings without order placement (PORTFOLIO_TRACKING).
typical_user_goal: Place or manage a stock order.
common_confusions: PORTFOLIO_TRACKING (viewing holdings); PRODUCT_DISCOVERY_MARKET_DATA (researching before trading); GENERAL_CROSS_JOURNEY (app-wide performance issues).
notes: Supported by 18 Phase B incidents. Order-specific inability and missing order-entry context; not generic UI discomfort.

definition: Viewing own holdings, balances, profit/loss, or chart state for the user portfolio.
include_when: The incident describes missing portfolio P&L, missing balance display, unsaved chart settings, or display-only balance issues without confirmed movement failure.
exclude_when: The incident describes a confirmed deposit/withdrawal failure (FUNDING_CASH_TRANSFER) or price-board quote freshness (PRODUCT_DISCOVERY_MARKET_DATA).
common_confusions: FUNDING_CASH_TRANSFER (confirmed movement failure); PRODUCT_DISCOVERY_MARKET_DATA (market data, not own holdings).
notes: Supported by 8 Phase B incidents. Display-only issues; do not infer failed transfers.

definition: Finding, researching, or monitoring stocks, market data, price boards, and investment research content.
include_when: The incident describes missing or stale price board data, stock screening/search issues, chart indicator issues, or research content quality.
exclude_when: The incident describes viewing own holdings (PORTFOLIO_TRACKING) or placing an order (TRADING_ORDER_MANAGEMENT).
notes: Supported by 14 Phase B incidents. Market data and research; not own portfolio.

definition: The incident is about the support interaction itself: reachability, response time, answer quality, or AI assistant behavior.
include_when: The incident describes inability to reach support, slow or scripted responses, irrelevant answers, or AI assistant quality issues.
exclude_when: The incident describes an underlying product failure with support only mentioned as context. Preserve the underlying product journey as primary.
typical_user_goal: Obtain timely, useful help from support.
common_confusions: Any underlying product journey (FUNDING, TRADING, etc.) when support is mentioned but the failure is elsewhere.
notes: Supported by 9 Phase B incidents. Support interaction only; do not collapse with underlying product failure.

definition: The issue genuinely affects multiple journey stages or the whole app, such as app-wide performance, overall UI complexity, or device-level issues.
include_when: The incident describes app-wide lag/freeze/crash, overall UI complexity that affects multiple tasks, device-specific issues (tablet, mobile data), or general praise/feature requests not tied to a specific journey.
exclude_when: The incident can be located in a specific journey stage. Do not use CROSS_JOURNEY merely because a review is vague.
typical_user_goal: Use the app generally across multiple tasks.
common_confusions: UNKNOWN (insufficient evidence to locate); specific journey stages when the failure is actually localized.
notes: Supported by 53 Phase B incidents (largest category). Includes app-wide performance, UX complexity, praise, and device-level issues. 3 UNCLEAR theme incidents recoded to UNKNOWN.

definition: A clear journey exists conceptually but does not fit any current model stage.
include_when: The incident describes a real experience problem that cannot be located in any defined journey stage but the journey is conceptually identifiable.
exclude_when: The incident can be located in a defined journey stage, or the evidence is insufficient (use UNKNOWN instead).
typical_user_goal: Not applicable; used as a catch-all for unmodeled journey locations.
notes: No Phase B incidents remain in this category after recoding. Retained as a safety valve for future evidence.

definition: Review evidence is insufficient to locate the incident in any journey stage.
include_when: The incident has insufficient evidence to determine a journey location, or the review text is too vague/short to classify.
exclude_when: The incident can be located in a defined journey stage, even if the pain-point family is unclear.
typical_user_goal: Not applicable; used when journey cannot be determined.
common_confusions: OTHER (journey exists but unmodeled); GENERAL_CROSS_JOURNEY (app-wide but locatable).
notes: 4 Phase B incidents after recoding (3 UNCLEAR theme + 1 praise with no context). Do not use for vague reviews that can be located.
